# Python Expert — PEP 8, type hints, testing and modern idioms for Python 3.10+

Curated by Skill Harbor — @personamanagmentlayer's python-expert (from the PCL Standard Library examples): an expert Python developer skill for Python 3.10+. Core principles: PEP 8 with Black defaults (88-char lines), type hints on every function signature (typing module, TypeAlias), robust error handling with specific exception types and context managers (no bare except), modern idioms (f-strings, pathlib over os.path, dataclasses/Pydantic, docstrings, @property), plus testing discipline with pytest, performance rules (profile before optimizing, generators, builtins), ready-to-copy templates (type-hinted functions, validating dataclasses, resource context managers), anti-patterns with fixes (mutable default arguments, bare exceptions), and a curated tools list (Black, ruff, mypy, pytest, pydantic, httpx, rich, typer).
